title: Zero-total-mass reduction and obstruction to the Euler integral
exact_target: Find whether the exceptional zero-total-mass restricted three-body model has the further first integral asked for in the source.

status_qualification: The signed-mass model, degree-of-freedom convention and admissible class of integrals need specification.
